rationale: Artem's deep expertise in efficient inference, transformer optimization, and real-time VLM acceleration directly complements Georgi's vision of agentic workflow automation at scale — Rilo's multi-agent GTM platform needs the kind of model efficiency and inference speed that Artem has built (loopvlm, quantization work). Georgi's conviction that AI agents should own outcomes rather than just tasks aligns with Artem's focus on making frontier models faster and more accessible, and Georgi is actively hiring for execution-focused roles where Artem's hands-on builder track record could be valuable.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Georgi — he's building agentic automation for startup GTM workflows at Rilo and needs the kind of efficient inference and model optimization expertise you've demonstrated with loopvlm and transformer acceleration work.
